title: Vehicle rental
blip_description: Rent a vehicle for a while. Deposit back on return.
subtitle: Deposit {deposit}, given back on return
rent_confirm: Rent the {label} for {minutes} min? Price {price} + deposit {deposit}.
return_desc: {label} [{plate}] · park it near this desk, empty · deposit {deposit} back
busy: An operation is already in progress.
not_at_desk: You must be at a rental desk.
already_renting: You already have a rental running.
unknown_model: This vehicle is not for rent.
spawn_blocked: The parking bay is blocked. Nothing was charged.
spawn_failed: The vehicle could not be delivered ({reason}). You were refunded.
rented: {label} rented for {minutes} min, plate {plate}. Paid {price} + deposit {deposit}.
too_far: Bring the vehicle closer to this desk.
occupied: Nobody may sit in the vehicle when you return it.
ended: Your rental of the {label} was ended. Deposit refunded: {deposit}.
vehicle_lost: Your rented {label} is gone: the rental is over, the deposit is lost.
rental_back: Your rental of the {label} [{plate}] is still running ({minutes} min left).
warning: Your rental of the {label} ends in {minutes} min. Return it to a desk to get your deposit back.
expired: Your rental of the {label} is over: the vehicle was taken back, the deposit is lost.
expired_occupied: Your rental of the {label} is over: leave the vehicle, it will be taken back.
stopped: The rental service stopped: your rental of the {label} is over.
